description: Source code for PlatformCapsData class handling device capabilities, quirks, browser info, plugin management, and configuration parsing in a media device environment.

classes.name: PlatformCapsData
classes.description: Class managing device capabilities, quirks, browser info, plugin configurations, and feature flags.

methods.name: AddDashExclusionList
methods.description: Adds DASH playback exclusions based on RFC and device properties.

methods.name: GetQuirks
methods.description: Returns a list of device quirks based on environment and compile-time flags.

methods.name: GetBrowser
methods.description: Determines browser type and user agent string from configuration files.

methods.name: SupportsTrueSD
methods.description: Indicates if TrueSD is supported based on compile-time flags.

methods.name: CanMixPCMWithSurround
methods.description: Checks if PCM can be mixed with surround sound based on device output ports.

methods.name: GetFirmwareUpdateDisabled
methods.description: Checks if firmware update is disabled based on the presence of a specific file.

methods.name: DeviceCapsFeatures
methods.description: Returns a map of device capability features, including support for various HTML and video features, plugins, and 4K decoding.

methods.name: GetMimeTypes
methods.description: Placeholder for retrieving supported MIME types.

methods.name: getAvailablePlugins
methods.description: Reads plugin configuration files and returns a map of available plugins.

methods.name: verifyLibraries
methods.description: Verifies existence of plugin libraries listed in configuration.
